subject.title: Add Model and Token Usage Status Display to Control UI Topbar

question: Should the Control UI add a persistent topbar model/token/quota status, and if so which canonical session/model/provider-usage fields should it display?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but placement, density, freshness semantics, and whether token status means context window, last reply tokens, provider quota, or cost require maintainer product intent.

options.title: Define topbar contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the exact compact fields, stale/unavailable states, responsive behavior, and source data before implementation.

options.title: Decline topbar placement
options.body: Close after a maintainer decision and document Chat controls, Usage, Overview, /status, and /usage as the supported usage visibility surfaces.

options.title: Split by placement
options.body: Track chat-specific quota widgets in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167 and provider billing dashboard work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100494 while reserving this issue for active-model topbar placement.

recommendation.title: Define topbar contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the exact compact fields, stale/unavailable states, responsive behavior, and source data before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current trail for Control UI product placement and prior review context on this specific issue.
